author: Temminck, 1835
status: 나그네새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만) · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)

months.note: 4~5월에 부산 부근에 잠시 들르며, 번식지에서의 산란기는 6~7월이다.

summary: 해마다 수십 마리가 지나가는 나그네새로, 4~5월에 작은 무리가 부산 부근에 잠깐 들른다. 주로 아고산대 침엽수림에서 번식하며, 벼랑의 움푹한 곳이나 나무뿌리 가까운 땅 위에 둥지를 틀고 알을 3~5개 낳는다. 곤충을 주로 먹는다. 일본에서 번식하고 중국 동남부에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: orange head, throat and upper breast

art.subject: Japanese Robin (Larvivora akahige), adult male on spring passage in April and May: forehead, face, sides of the neck, throat and upper breast bright orange-rufous, the orange reaching up onto the forehead; crown, nape, back and wings warm rufous-brown; rump and tail brighter rufous-chestnut; a thin blackish line divides the orange breast from the grey lower breast; lower breast and flanks blue-grey, the centre of the belly paler whitish-grey; bill blackish; large dark eye; legs pale pinkish-brown.
art.pose: perched low near the ground, side view
art.scene: Korean spring woodland undergrowth near the southern coast; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched on a low branch: orange-rufous forehead, face, throat and upper breast, warm rufous-brown back, brighter rufous tail, thin black line then grey lower breast and flanks, black bill, pinkish legs
adult male, front view perched: orange-rufous throat and upper breast cut off below by a thin black line, grey lower breast and flanks, whitish-grey centre of the belly
art.build: Small, robin-shaped chat about 14cm, a little larger than a sparrow but rounder and bigger-headed, with long legs and an upright stance; often stands still on the ground or a low perch and flicks the tail. Bill thin, straight, black, shorter than the head. Legs long and slender, pale pinkish-brown. Wings short and rounded: at rest the wingtips just pass the base of the tail. Tail medium length, square, rufous-chestnut, brighter than the back, often raised; no wing-bars or pale eyebrow.
avoid: Do not paint a black face and throat; that is the male Ryukyu Robin (Larvivora komadori).
Do not paint blue upperparts and a white underside as on the male Siberian Blue Robin (Larvivora cyane).
Do not paint spots, streaks, wing-bars or a pale eyebrow; the plumage is plain.
Do not paint the tail dark brown or black; it is bright rufous.
